limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter rollover but also made `ready_a` high during reset and gated `valid_b` with `valid_a`, changing the original behavior when input stalls before the sixth bit.

The test exercised reset and sixth-bit stalls, but its expected outputs encoded the rewrite's always-high `ready_a` and sixth-bit-only `valid_b`, so it could not flag either deviation from the reference behavior.
